board_run_note: No board run was made yet. This file is a host-side measurement plan and accounting record; it contains no device measurements.

environment.identity: not collected because this is a plan

host_accounting.accounting_scope: Board-free host model: circular-buffer pages, resident tensors, largest assigned core, and static L1 prefix. These are not device measurements.

first_launch_plan.purpose: Launch the new FP32-R kernel once under Watcher before any timing comparison.

comparison_plan.seed_source: random_hpd_batch condition_number=100.0 seed=6300; one matrix batch is reused for matching variants

rows.name: fp32-r-L32-r-dram
rows.configuration_note: Nearest fitting placement for the selected block-8 default; no silent fallback is performed.

metrics.correctness_launch: one synchronized launch and result download before timing for every row
metrics.latency: each retained per-launch duration from one synchronized warm-up followed by exactly 1000 synchronized launches
metrics.latency_summary: all samples plus min, p50, p99, and p99.9
metrics.tflops: fixed-N=12 useful workload divided by each latency summary statistic; p50 and min derivations are retained
metrics.inverse_error: relative Frobenius error against the matching independent NumPy fixed-N=12 reference and against the true inverse of original R
metrics.mv_direction: 1 - absolute normalized direction cosine for the equal-spaced half-wavelength array over look directions -30,-15,0,15,30 degrees, aggregated over the batch
metrics.beam_pattern: same-array response relative Frobenius error and maximum absolute error over look directions -30,-15,0,15,30 degrees and pattern directions -60 through 60 degrees in 15-degree steps, aggregated over the batch
metrics.device_gate: existing 1e-2 device-test relative-error assertion is recorded unchanged and is not redefined by this plan
metrics.row_stop: a row exceeding 60 seconds is recorded as a failure and stops later rows without retry

correctness.true_inverse: NumPy complex128 inverse of the unrounded deterministic R

measurement_provenance_to_capture.watcher_and_timeout: record effective settings for the first launch and timing comparison

decision_scope: Evidence only. This plan does not select BF16-R or FP32-R and does not change ADR-0012, ADR-0013, or the 1e-2 device gate.
limitations: No board, container, device node, or hardware command was used to create this record.
Latency, TFLOPS, inverse, MV-direction, and beam-pattern measurements remain null until the owner-authorized board run.
The FP32-R L=32 timing row uses explicit R-in-DRAM placement because the default R-in-L1 preflight rejects before allocation; block 2 with R in L1 is also recorded as an explicit fitting alternative.
